Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.jmf23D

Class HTMLParser

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.jmf23D.AbstractParser
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.jmf23D.HTMLParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.media.Controls, javax.media.Demultiplexer, javax.media.Duration, javax.media.MediaHandler, javax.media.PlugIn
public class HTMLParser extends AbstractParser
A JMF demultiplexer that takes HTML as input and outputs RGB data. Because of the lack of a proper open source HTML rendering component in java/swing, it currently uses javax.swing.JEditorPane to render html pages, and thus can't render most pages correctly. There is no system to this day to forward the mouse events to this class. This class only serves the purpose of displaying static html content.
